# Invalid namespace forms

```tsx
import * as DestructuredRoot from 'annota';
import type * as TypeRoot from 'annota';

const { PointTool: NamespacePoint } = DestructuredRoot;
type InvalidToolType = TypeRoot.PointTool;

require('annota').PointTool;
(await import('annota')).loadH5Masks;

const { ['PointTool']: ComputedPoint } = require('annota');

const RootNamespace = require('annota');
const RootAlias = RootNamespace;
let AssignedAlias;
AssignedAlias = RootAlias;
const { loadH5Masks: AliasedLoader } = AssignedAlias;

let LaterAlias;
LaterAlias = await import('annota');
({ PointTool: LaterPoint } = LaterAlias);
```
